What is Rust's ownership model?

What is Rust's ownership model?

What is Ownership? - The Rust Programming Language
doc.rust-lang
Rust (programming language) - Wikipedia
wikipedia

Rust manages memory through ownership: every value has a single owner, and the value is dropped when the owner goes out of scope.rust-lang+2 Borrowing lets code use a value without taking ownership.2

Key rules

  1. Each value has one owner.rust-lang

  2. There can be one owner at a time.

Example

rust
fn main() {
    let s1 = String::from("hello");
    let s2 = s1; // s1 is moved

    println!("{s2}");
}
